solver: scikit-fem P2 electrostatics (AMG-CG) on gmsh; vector FEM N2/P2 arm modes (eoref.fmode, h_core 40 nm, half window + TE mirror); first-order Pockels perturbation

definitions.frame: lab x lateral, y film normal (up), z propagation; x-cut LN, propagation crystal y; lab x = crystal z (n_e, eps par), lab y = crystal x, lab z = crystal y; crystal +z along lab +x
definitions.voltage: V = 1 V terminal difference (signal 1 V, grounds 0 V); every per-volt quantity is per volt of V
definitions.arms: A = right gap (x > 0), B = left gap (x < 0); each arm mode solved in its own window, electrodes absent
definitions.dn_full: dn_eff/V = int E* . d(eps_r)/dV . E dA / (4 P'), P' = (1/2) Re int (E x H'*) . z dA, H' = Z0 H; equals (omega eps0 / (4 P k0)) int E* . d eps . E dA in SI; full 3m Pockels tensor
definitions.delta_eps: d(eps_r)_ab = -eps_a eps_b d(1/eps)_ab, d(1/eps)_I = r_Ik E_k (crystal frame, contracted), eps_x = n_e^2, eps_y = eps_z = n_o^2 (1550 nm optical indices), static field E_s from the ES solve
definitions.split_component: each lab d eps component is linear in exactly one r coefficient: r33 -> d eps_xx = -n_e^4 r33 E_x,s (term d eps_xx |E_x|^2); r13 -> d eps_yy = d eps_zz = -n_o^4 r13 E_x,s (terms d eps_yy |E_y|^2 + d eps_zz |E_z|^2); r51 -> d eps_xy = -n_e^2 n_o^2 r51 E_y,s (term 2 d eps_xy Re(E_x* E_y)); r22 -> d eps_yz = +n_o^4 r22 E_y,s (term 2 d eps_yz Re(E_y* E_z)); contribution = integral of that coefficient's terms of E* . d eps . E divided by 4 P'; the four contributions sum to dn_full
definitions.split_region: ln_slab = elements labelled ln_slab; ln_rib = elements labelled ln_rib*; other = all non-LN elements (zero by construction: Pockels tensor non-zero only in LN)
definitions.gamma_E2: Gamma = (g / V) int_LN E_x,s |E_opt|^2 dA / int_window |E_opt|^2 dA, |E_opt|^2 = |E_x|^2 + |E_y|^2 + |E_z|^2 of the arm mode; g = edge-to-edge gap of that arm from the electrode rectangles; signed (A > 0, B < 0)
definitions.gamma_Ex2: as gamma_E2 with |E_x,opt|^2 in numerator and denominator (DevLog-028 gamma_scalar)
definitions.vpil_textbook: push-pull, V across each gap = terminal voltage: dn_tb,arm = -(1/2) n_e^3 r33 Gamma_arm / g_arm, VpiL_tb = lambda / (2 |dn_tb,A - dn_tb,B|) = lambda g / (2 n_e^3 r33 Gamma_mean) for equal gaps (the single-arm textbook lambda g / (n_e^3 r33 Gamma) halved); no n_e/n_eff factor
definitions.vpil_textbook_neff: VpiL_tb x n_eff / n_e (textbook with the effective-index factor: uniform-field limit dn = -(1/2) n_e^3 r33 (n_e / n_eff) Gamma V / g)
definitions.gamma_equiv: 2 g |dn_full,arm| / (n_e^3 r33): the Gamma that reproduces the full-tensor dn in the textbook formula (informational)
definitions.W: W' = (eps0 / 2) int eps_rf |grad phi|^2 dA over the whole domain, J/m at V = 1 V (= C' V^2 / 2)
definitions.lineint_slabmid: int (-E) . dl along the straight segment at the LN slab mid-height (y = slab centre) from the signal electrode edge x to the ground electrode edge x of that arm's gap, dl pointing from signal to ground; = phi(ground end) - phi(signal end) (negative, |value| < 1 V because the endpoints lie below the electrodes); exact quadrature with breakpoints at element edges
definitions.lineint_electrode_bottom: same at the electrode bottom height (endpoints are electrode corners): identity, = -V = -1 V

uncertainty: U by the DevLog-028 round-2 rule (eoref.util.richardson, p_formal 2, three finest ES levels; optical mesh fixed at h_core 40 nm, see optical_mesh_check)
